Abstract summary: Recent sequence modeling approaches using selective state space sequence models, referred to as Mamba models, have seen a surge of interest. These models allow efficient processing of long sequences in linear time and are rapidly being adopted in a wide range of applications such as language modeling, demonstrating promising performance.  Out of scope: Mamba explainability algorithm; efficient Mamba is context, not the contribution.
title: MambaLRP: Explaining Selective State Space Sequence Models
